scientific_integrity: The derived return clock and laws are proved; finite supporting tests are not treated as an infinite proof. The conditional law uses the stationary induced entrance distribution, not uniform Lebesgue entrants.
scientific_limitations: Applies to annealed iid Pareto parameters and the alpha-zero wide-entrance map; no general alpha-positive or quenched theorem.
The sharp stationary constant is an induced-measure expectation, not a closed-form universal number.
The original full preprint was examined; a complete comparison with all revised journal content and general renewal literature was not possible.
title: Pareto excursion tails and entrance-depth selection in a random convex interval map
